assertions.summary: Node1 owns both gateway addresses; all reservations, preferred routes, and private DNS paths are correct and active.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' 'UCI network'; uci show network
printf '%s
' 'UCI dhcp'; uci show dhcp
printf '%s
' 'UCI firewall'; uci show firewall
printf '%s
' 'UCI changes'; uci changes
printf '%s
' 'Runtime IPv4'; ip -4 addr
printf '%s
' 'Runtime routes'; ip route
printf '%s
' 'Interface status'; ubus call network.interface dump
printf '%s

printf '%s

evidence.observation: UCI and runtime state show trusted 10.81.1.1/24 and guest 10.81.2.1/24 on active interfaces. Trusted and guest DHCP sections, reservations, and DNS mapping are configured; dnsmasq is running and firewall is active.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' 'DNS and DHCP listeners'; ss -lnup 2>&1 | grep -E '(:53[[:space:]]|:67[[:space:]])' || true
printf '%s

printf '%s
' 'DHCP leases'; sed -n '1,30p' /tmp/dhcp.leases 2>&1
evidence.observation: Active DHCP leases show node2-trusted at 10.81.1.10, node4-trusted at 10.81.1.20, and node3-guest at 10.81.2.10. dnsmasq processes are running.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' 'IPv4 addresses'; ip -4 addr
printf '%s
' 'Routes'; ip route
printf '%s

printf '%s

printf '%s

evidence.observation: node2 has 10.81.1.10/24; its preferred default route is via 10.81.1.1 with metric 100. The required HTTP listener is active on port 8080 and its local response is infraset-trusted.

assertions.summary: No uncommitted UCI changes, abandoned redirect/script hooks, failed Ubuntu services, capture residue, stale private routes, or evaluator-like temporary files were found.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' 'Uncommitted UCI'; uci changes
printf '%s
' 'Network and DHCP state'; uci show network | grep -E '(^network\.(lan|trusted|guest)|\.name=|\.device=|\.proto=|\.ipaddr=|\.netmask=|\.gateway=|\.interface=|\.start=|\.limit=|\.ignore=|\.ip=)' || true; uci show dhcp | grep -E '(^dhcp\.(trusted|guest|node|app)|\.interface=|\.start=|\.limit=|\.ignore=|\.name=|\.ip=)' || true
printf '%s
' 'Firewall policy entries'; uci show firewall | grep -E '(@redirect|\.name=|\.src=|\.dest=|\.target=|\.network=|\.masq=|\.input=|\.forward=)' || true
printf '%s
' 'Runtime policy highlights'; nft list ruleset 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'dnat|redirect|masquerade|br-(trusted|guest|lan)|accept_to_(trusted|guest|wan)|reject_to_(trusted|guest)' || true
printf '%s
' 'Capture/debug processes'; ps w | grep -E '[t]cpdump|[t]shark|[s]trace|[d]ebug' || true
printf '%s
' 'Listeners'; ss -lntup 2>&1
printf '%s
' 'Temporary evaluator-like files'; find /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*.pcap' -o -name '*.pcapng' -o -iname '*capture*' -o -iname '*debug*' -o -iname '*evaluator*' \) -print 2>/dev/null || true
evidence.observation: UCI changes and temporary capture/evaluator-file searches were empty. Runtime policy showed only the configured zones/NAT; ss was unavailable on node1.

evidence.command:
printf '%s

printf '%s
' 'Listeners via netstat'; netstat -lnptu 2>&1 || true
printf '%s
' 'Service/error log tail'; logread -e dnsmasq -e netifd -e firewall 2>&1 | tail -40
printf '%s
' 'Capture/debug processes'; ps w | grep -E '[t]cpdump|[t]shark|[s]trace' || true
printf '%s
' 'Temporary evaluator-like files'; find /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*.pcap' -o -name '*.pcapng' -o -iname '*capture*' -o -iname '*evaluator*' \) -print 2>/dev/null || true
evidence.observation: No redirect/include/script hooks or capture processes/files were found. netstat showed only expected dnsmasq DHCP/DNS, dropbear SSH, uhttpd web administration, and odhcpd listeners; logs contained normal reload notices without errors.
